Vicky wrote nothing; she has now been silent for 17 days, since her termination message at 00:00 on Aug 18. Every open item from last week aged another seven days completely untouched — the Infloww disconnection she explicitly asked for is still unconfirmed at 17 days, Mayson's 'I’ll get you an answer shortly Valeri!' is 17 days old, Derrek's 'give me another hour and ill answer you and update you on all of this' is 25 days old, the whale list is 66 days old, Jake's $700 call 63 days, Michelle's IG handle 42 days.
